posts.title: A challenge for a better community
posts.description: Did you know that all ACM-sponsored conferences have an anti-harassment policy? I didn’t, until I chaired the Haskell Symposium last year. posts.title: Borderline, just semantics
posts.description: I want to discuss two moral aspects of how to talk about borderline people (e.g., whether to say “MTF” or “female”, “smart” or “good at math”). The first aspect is what category of people we should be talking about, never mind how we talk about it.
